newsitem.title: TURKEY: Angry Turkish landlord tries to blast tenant out.
newsitem.headline: Angry Turkish landlord tries to blast tenant out.

text.p: A landlord trying to evict a reluctant tenant in Turkey's eastern province of Erzurum, tossed sticks of dynamite into the house to force him out, Anatolian news agency reported on Tuesday.
Landlord Zihni Colak decided to evict tenant Hanifi Demirtas after an argument about payment of rent.
After Demirtas refused to leave the house, Colak climbed onto the roof of the house armed with sticks of dynamite, again demanding the tenant quit the property, the report said.
When Demirtas, who had just woken up, again refused to leave, the irate landlord lit the fuses and threw the dynamite into the house.
The dynamite was thrown out of the house before it exploded with no damage to life or property, but both men were subsequently arrested. The house is now empty, the agency said.
